g.text: The rover shall fit a 170 mm x 170 mm
footprint with 50 mm x 20 mm wheels,
The rover shall carry VIPER's recognisable
features: a box body, a wheel at each
panels on the rear, left and right, and a
All structural parts shall print in PLA on a
180 mm x 180 mm bed without supports.
The rover shall hold a commanded speed
of 2 cm/s on level ground, within 10%.
The rover shall climb a 15 degree slope
and turn on the spot on the chosen demo
The rover shall run for at least 2 hours of
continuous driving on one set of cells.
The rover shall accept waypoint commands
over Wi-Fi and report position, heading and
The rover shall stop within 1 s if commands
Total parts cost shall stay under GBP 300,
